odo_varrick.name: Odo Varrick
odo_varrick.title: wool merchant of Highmarsh
odo_varrick.voice: A merchant pays for what lasts the road.

brindlewick_muster.name: Reeve Tamsin Hale
brindlewick_muster.title: for the Brindlewick muster
brindlewick_muster.voice: The village looks after its own.

highmarsh_watch.name: Captain Hedda Rourke
highmarsh_watch.title: of the Highmarsh Watch
highmarsh_watch.voice: The watch remembers who armed it.

merchants_guild.name: Guildmaster Corvin Ashby
merchants_guild.title: of the Merchants' Guild
merchants_guild.voice: The Guild buys only matched work.

warden_aldwin.name: Lord Aldwin Tarrow
warden_aldwin.title: Warden of the Western Marches
warden_aldwin.voice: A warden's men are only as good as their steel.

royal_household.name: The Royal Household
royal_household.title: by the hand of Queen Ysolde's steward
royal_household.voice: The Crown does not ask twice.

templates.title: Hatchets and bucklers for the drovers' road
templates.text: Odo Varrick's drovers take the wool down the marsh road every spring, and the road has teeth. He wants twelve iron hatchets and eight iron bucklers, plain and sound.

templates.title: Helms and shields for the village muster
templates.text: Since the wolves came down from the Greywood the reeve keeps a muster of farmhands. She asks for ten iron helms and six round shields for them.

templates.title: Forty blades and twenty round shields for the Highmarsh Watch
templates.text: The Highmarsh Watch is doubling its patrols on the causeway. Captain Rourke wants forty iron shortswords and twenty round shields — and a captain's longsword for herself, worthy of the post.

templates.title: A matched set of twelve steel blades for the Merchants' Guild
templates.text: The Guild arms its caravan masters with matched steel, silver-chased at the hilt. Twelve steel shortswords of one weight and one temper — and a rapier for the Guildmaster's own hip.

templates.title: Armour for a captain's company
templates.text: Lord Aldwin is raising a company to hold the western fords. Ten coats of iron chainmail and ten iron helms, garnet-pinned with the Warden's badge — and a steel cuirass for their captain.

templates.title: Ceremonial arms for the Queen's Guard
templates.text: Word of the Ironhand forge has reached the court. The Royal Household commissions twelve steel longswords and twelve kite shields for the Queen's Guard, silver-chased and garnet-set — and a sword of state to be carried before the Queen.
